courses.note: Elective (neither AI nor ML is required; the major needs three 300+ electives). CSCI 373 and CSCI 374 are each offered about every other year; CSCI 374 was last offered Spring 2025 but only an undated old syllabus (virtual office hours, likely 2020-21) is public, so the dated Spring 2023 CSCI 373 site was kept. Its only collaboration rule is the '50 ft rule' with no external resources on exams; it does not mention AI tools. Catalog and requirements pages returned 403 to direct fetch, so the course list comes from search summaries.
